quests.canDoWhy: It begins on a level-up. A disturbed Argonian, From-Deepest-Fathoms, turns up on the Riften docks and begs you to take a Lexicon back to Avanchnzel.

starts.how: After you level up, From-Deepest-Fathoms wanders the Riften docks. Speak to her and she gives you the Lexicon to return to Avanchnzel.

takesYou.why: carry the Lexicon back. Inside you see visions of the earlier expedition (Breya, Drennen, Watches-The-Roots) and find their bodies

rewards.when: when you return the Lexicon in Avanchnzel

people.name: From-Deepest-Fathoms
people.role: gives you the Lexicon; wanders the Riften docks

people.name: Keerava
people.role: innkeeper of the Bee and Barb, who can speak about her during the quest

people.name: Breya, Drennen, Watches-The-Roots
people.role: From-Deepest-Fathoms' old companions, seen in visions and found dead in Avanchnzel

unsure.why: It starts from a level-up event. The level it waits for isn't in these files.
The journal says she wanders the Riften docks, and her only package is a wander package. Her placed record, though, is in Haelga's Bunkhouse, so where you first meet her may vary.
Ancient Knowledge exists in two records, a shown one and a hidden one. What it does isn't in these files.

evidence: giver INFO Skyrim.esm:02B99E From-Deepest-Fathoms (below 10); Keerava below 91
NPC Skyrim.esm:01335A ref 019DE2 in 016BD4; package MS04FDFWander

quests.name: The Man Who Cried Wolf
quests.plugin: Skyrim.esm (last edited by Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)
quests.canDoWhy: In the Blue Palace in Solitude, Varnius Junius of Dragon Bridge asks the court for help with Wolfskull Cave; ask Falk Firebeard about it.

starts.how: Enter the Blue Palace while the court is hearing Varnius Junius' appeal from Dragon Bridge. Then ask Falk Firebeard about Wolfskull Cave and he asks you to clear it out.

quests.firstStep: Ask Falk Firebeard about Wolfskull Cave

takesYou.why: stop the necromancers' ritual to summon Potema, the Wolf Queen
report back to Falk

objectives: Ask Falk Firebeard about Wolfskull Cave

rewards.when: from Falk when you report back

people.name: Falk Firebeard
people.role: Elisif's steward; gives the job and takes your report; Blue Palace

people.name: Varnius Junius
people.role: the Dragon Bridge representative who brings the appeal; afterwards goes back to Dragon Bridge

people.name: Elisif the Fair, Sybille Stentor, Bolgeir Bearclaw
people.role: the court in the opening scene; Sybille's scrying says there's nothing there

people.name: Ritual Master
people.role: the necromancer leading the ritual in Wolfskull Cave

unsure.why: The quest runs from game start, and the court scene is set off by a trigger in the Blue Palace. When the scene will play (any time, or only during court hours) isn't in these files.

The Wolf Queen Awakened starts on a location change (an Unofficial Patch fix), and a 'Letter from Falk Firebeard' asks you to come back to Solitude. These files don't say how long after this quest that happens.
The medium leveled reward is named by the quest's script; no journal line says Falk pays you.

evidence: QUST Skyrim.esm:093807 start-game enabled, stages 15/50/100/250, objectives 15/50/100
giver INFO Skyrim.esm:0D8E94 Bolgeir (below 6), with Elisif, Falk, Sybille
